$comment: Machine-readable names for citrus-orange/frame_identity_v1_2026-10-12.md. A frame-reference field name must end with one of counter_suffixes and hold that counter; a table uses one counter by table_kinds.

recording_frame_id.counts: frames Orange received while recording, per camera
recording_frame_id.resets: new recording only (not clip boundaries, not pauses)

stream_frame_id.counts: frames Orange received since this camera's stream opened, preview included
stream_frame_id.video_join_via: Orange recording metadata (stream_frame_id and recording_frame_id on every row)

stimulus_frame_num.counts: stimulus frames Citrus computed and displayed, per H5 file

camera_binding.shaman_v2: one queue per camera; slot camera_id and camera_serial
camera_binding.citrus_h5: one camera per file: /correspondence/acquisition/binding_json camera_serial, acquisition_camera_id, shaman_numeric_camera_id

position_names.video_frame_index: 0-based position in one video file, with its clip
position_names.display_frame_index: Citrus process-wide display frame count; not a frame reference
